lead: Tuesday's center of gravity was Washington: [Trump released a voluntary AI accord with tech leaders](../summaries/fe9056ddb087.md), calling it ['morally binding'](../summaries/68d1b506dd06.md) while [rejecting new federal rules](../summaries/c968463efde7.md) and [ordering agencies to say 'Super Intelligence'](../summaries/93a590deaf4e.md). [Anthropic warned that GLM-5.3 spreads autonomous cyber-exploit capability without safeguards](../summaries/2415274ff349.md), [Bain put a $6T revenue question under the data-center boom](../summaries/a6b0c693a7ba.md), and [Reuters revealed McDonald's AI-driven pricing engine](../summaries/c777d97378c8.md).

sections.title: Trump's voluntary accord
sections.intro: External auditors and internal alignment controls, promised voluntarily: the White House accord, the 'Super Intelligence' executive order, and Trump's case against new federal rules.

sections.title: GLM-5.3 and proliferating cyber capability
sections.intro: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team says autonomous exploit-building is no longer a one-lab capability - and that GLM-5.3 shipped without meaningful safeguards.

sections.title: The arithmetic of the boom
sections.intro: Bain's $6T revenue requirement, a discounted AI-infrastructure IPO, and what Anthropic's filing reveals about routing half its sales through Amazon and Google.

sections.title: AI decides what you pay - and how your home scores
sections.intro: McDonald's per-store 'optimal price' engine and Dallas's trash-truck 'blight scores': algorithmic judgment applied to wallets and neighborhoods.

sections.title: OpenAI's ignored warnings
sections.intro: The NYT reports OpenAI staff raised security alarms months before the Hugging Face incident; meanwhile the Thomson Reuters ruling against Ross Intelligence stands.

sections.title: Tools of the day
sections.intro: A 22KiB transformer trained in 13 seconds, a compiler harness for GPU agents, Amazon's ad-buying agent, Baseten inside Codex, and Christopher Olah on Claude and consciousness.
